'''Michael Lin''' ({{Langx|he|מיכאל לין}}; born June 8, 1942) is an Israeli [[mathematician]], who has published scientific articles in the field of [[probability]] concentrating on [[Markov chains]] and [[ergodic theory]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://65.54.113.26/Author/12895842/michael-lin |title=Microsoft academic search Michael Lin |access-date=2012-06-07 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20121129010351/http://65.54.113.26/Author/12895842/michael-lin |archive-date=2012-11-29 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.math.bgu.ac.il/~berend/probability_group.html |title=Probability Theory and Related Areas Research Group |publisher=Math.bgu.ac.il |date= |accessdate=2012-06-24}}</ref> He serves as professor emeritus at the Department of Mathematics in [[Ben-Gurion University of the Negev]] (BGU).<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.math.bgu.ac.il/people/emeritus.html |title=BGU Math Emeritus Faculty |publisher=Math.bgu.ac.il |accessdate=2012-06-24 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20081006090919/http://www.math.bgu.ac.il/people/emeritus.html |archivedate=2008-10-06 }}</ref> Additionally, he is a member of the academic board and serves as the academic coordinator at [[Achva Academic College]].<ref>[http://www.achva.ac.il/%D7%97%D7%95%D7%92/%D7%AA%D7%95%D7%90%D7%A8-%D7%A8%D7%90%D7%A9%D7%95%D7%9F-bsc-%D7%91%D7%9E%D7%93%D7%A2%D7%99%D7%9D/%D7%9E%D7%93%D7%A2%D7%99-%D7%94%D7%9E%D7%97%D7%A9%D7%91/full Achva Academic College - academic coordinators] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121112053037/http://www.achva.ac.il/%D7%97%D7%95%D7%92/%D7%AA%D7%95%D7%90%D7%A8-%D7%A8%D7%90%D7%A9%D7%95%D7%9F-bsc-%D7%91%D7%9E%D7%93%D7%A2%D7%99%D7%9D/%D7%9E%D7%93%D7%A2%D7%99-%D7%94%D7%9E%D7%97%D7%A9%D7%91/full |date=2012-11-12 }}</ref>

==Biography==
Michael Lin was born in Israel. He holds a [[Bachelor of Science]] in Mathematics and Physics from [[The Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] (1963), [[Master of Science]] in [[Mathematics]] (1967) and a PhD in Mathematics also from [[The Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] (1971). In 1971 he was appointed as an assistant professor in [[Ohio State University]]. In 1976 he returned to Israel and became a senior lecturer in the Department of Mathematics at [[Ben-Gurion University of the Negev|Ben-Gurion University]] of the Negev. Only 4 years later, at 1979, he became an associate professor and in 1984 he became a full professor. In 2011, Professor Lin retired and nowadays he serves as professor emeritus. During his career at Ben-Gurion University of the Negev he acted as:
* Computer Science Coordinator, Department of Mathematics and Computer Science, BGU.
* Member of BGU Computer Policy committee.
* Chairman and Computer Science Coordinator, Department of Mathematics and Computer Science, BGU.
* Senate representative to Executive Committee of Board of Trustees of BGU.
* Senate representative to the BGU Executive Committee's subcommittee for student affairs.
* President, [[Israel Mathematical Union]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://imu.org.il/ |title=Israel Mathematical Union |publisher=Imu.org.il |date= |accessdate=2012-06-24}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.hayadan.org.il/success-to-israel-in-math-conference-in-greece-1803081/ |title=הישגים נאים לנבחרת המתמטיקה הישראלית בתחרות בינלאומית באתונה &#124; הידען |publisher=Hayadan.org.il |date= 17 March 2008|accessdate=2012-06-24}}</ref>
* Head of the Ethical Code Committee of BGU.<ref>[http://in.bgu.ac.il/acadsec/DocLib/Pages/academic_members/v11-חברי_ועדות_במנהל_האקדמי_לתשעב.pdf members of BGU committees ]</ref>
In 2004 Professor Lin also acted as a member of the committee electing the recipients of the [[Israel Prize]] in mathematics.<ref>[http://cms.education.gov.il/EducationCMS/Units/Dovrut/Eruimveprasim/prasim/PrasMatmatika.htm PrasMatmatika.htm]</ref>

| doi=10.1016/0022-1236(73)90034-7 | doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal

| issue=1
| pages=81–94
| doi=10.1142/S0219493711003176}}</ref> More specifically, he researched in several areas: mean and individual [[Ergodic theory]],<ref>{{cite journal
